Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are set to open the innings. Mitchell Starc will bowl the first over.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the wicket is not the easiest, there is a little bit of grip on the surface and Australia have an excellent bowling attack. If they do get their lines and lengths right, it is not going to be easy to chase. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, do have a deep batting lineup and some sensible batting can see them take a 1-0 lead in the series. A good second half awaits so stay tuned.

The Lankans were really good in the Powerplay, they kept it tight and managed to get rid of Aaron Finch. Then the game started to drift away from them as Ben McDermott and Josh Inglis put up a good 50-run stand before being separated by Chamika Karunaratne. Sri Lanka then came back in the game courtesy of Wanindu Hasaranga who got 2 wickets quickly to push the Aussies on the back foot yet again. Chamika Karunaratn then got Ben McDermott and Sri Lanka were in control. Marcus Stoinis and Matthew Wade though counter-attacked, especially the former and at that stage, 180 looked possible. However, Binura Fernando was absolutely brilliant towards the death and he is the man reason Australia have ended with a score under par. He ended up with figures of 4-0-12-2 in a T20 game!

What a performance that is with the ball by Sri Lanka! They will be so delighted with their performance heading into the break. The Australians, on the other hand, will be very disappointed with how the game stands at the moment, have to say they are on the back foot at the moment. Only 25 runs came from the last 4 overs and Sri Lanka got 4 wickets!
Two to finish! Very full, on off. Driven to long on for a couple. Australia end at 149 for 9.
Very full and wide outside off. Josh Hazlewood gets no bat on it. What a show this has been by Sri Lanka in the last few overs!
Zampa shuffles across and Fernando fires a full one to follow him. Zampa is hit on the pads and the ball rolls away. A leg bye is taken.
Another dot! Yorker, outside off. Zampa misses. They try to take a bye but decide against it.
On a length, angling across off. Adam Zampa misses his punch.
Play and a miss! Very full, outside off. Zampa gets no bat on it.
Very full and outside off. Driven to deep cover for one. 3 runs and 2 wickets from the over. Great bowling.
Josh Hazlewood is the last batter.
OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! A full toss, on off. Cummins miscues the heave and the ball goes high in the air to long on. Chamika Karunaratne runs in and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamika Karunaratne b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, outside off. Zampa carves it to third man for one.
Adam Zampa is the new batter.
OUT! BOWLED! A brilliant show by Sri Lanka in the last few overs! Full and straight. Mitchell Starc shuffles across and looks to scoop but misses. The ball hits the stumps.
A wide yorker, outside off. Mitchell Starc fails to dig it out.
A low full toss, outside off. Driven to long on for one.
Wide yorker and Pat Cummins digs it past cover for one. What an over, 3 runs and 2 wickets!
A full toss! Not what he would have wanted to bowl! Starc pushes it to the right of the bowler. Fernando dives but cannot stop it. Single.
Mitchell Starc to play the hat-trick ball.
OUT! BOWLED! Binura Fernando is on a hat-trick now! Very full, around off. Marcus Stoinis goes for the thumping drive but gets the inside edge back on the stumps! Great bowling by Binura Fernando.
Pat Cummins walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! Sensational catch! Wade shuffles across and hits it aerially towards sweeper cover. Dasun Shanaka runs in from the fence, dives forward and takes a very good catch. Great effort by the skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Binura Fernando

Commentary.Commentary: A wide yorker and Wade fails to dig it out.

Yorker, outside off. Marcus Stoinis shuffles across and misses the flick. The ball hits the pads and rolls away. They take a leg bye and the throw by the fielder hits Marcus Stoinis on the left arm. There was an appeal for LBW but it was turned down.
Binura Fernando is back. Just 8 from his two overs.
A full toss swiped wide of long on and they get a couple now. 16 from the over.
Very full and outside off. Wade shuffles out but fails to dig it out. Wide called and that is a harsh call.
Shorter, slower and outside off. Pulled to long on for one.
SIX! That is nailed! Dushmantha Chameera misses his mark and bowls a full one, outside off. Marcus Stoinis clears his front leg and smokes it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Very full, on off. Stoinis uses his bottom hand and drills it down the ground. Two taken as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
FOUR! Just over the fielder! Shorter, slower and outside off. Marcus Stoinis hangs his bat out while looking to punch. It balloons and goes over the leap of backward point. It runs to the fence.
Slower ball, wide outside off. Marcus Stoinis looks to drive but misses. Not called a wide.
Dushmantha Chameera is back. 19 from his first two overs.
A single as this is driven to long off. 13 from the over.
Flatter, lands on off and turns away. Stoinis is beaten as he looks to push it away.
FOUR! Lofted away! Tossed up, wide outside off. Marcus Stoinis reaches out and lofts it over point. The man at sweeper cover runs to his left and dives but cannot stop it.
Shorter and outside off. Marcus Stoinis chops it past short third man for a couple.
SIX! Smoked! Darted down the leg side. Stoinis gets low and sweeps it way over the fine leg fence.
Flatter, on middle. Marcus Stoinis looks to reverse sweep but gets hit on the pads.
Maheesh Theekshana is back. He went for 14 in his first two overs. There is a fielder right behind the umpire. Not the umpire at square leg. The bowler at the bowler's end.
Shorter and outside off. Marcus Stoinis slaps it past point for one.
The slower ball, on a length, wide outside off. Wade drives it to deep point for one.
Shorter and outside off. Slapped past point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Punched past cover for one.

OUT! LBW! The time is up! Ben McDermott reviews it but the umpire informs that the time is up! Wonder why he had such a long discussion with Stoinis. Length ball, on middle. He looks to whip it away but misses. The ball hits the pads and there is a big appeal. Up goes the finger. The batters have a chat but the time is up when they decide to review it. Well, it wouldn't have mattered as the ball was crashing into the stumps! Matthew Wade walks out to bat.
Length ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Shorter, on off. Pushed to long on for one. Wanindu Hasaranga ends with figures of 4-0-38-3. Good day in the field for him.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Brilliant work by Wanindu Hasaranga! He bowls it very full, just outside off. Smith loses his balance as he looks to whip it away and misses. The ball lands and comes back in. It goes on and hits the stumps.
Two now! Shorter, on middle. Worked past mid-wicket. They run for the second and Ben McDermott dives as the throw comes in. The fielder misses though.
Tossed up, on off. Ben McDermott sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter, on off. Smith backs away and taps it to cover for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, on middle. Smith drives it straight down the ground. The man at long on has no chance. Boundary.
Direct hit and Ben McDermott was out! Shorter and on off, Smith guides it to short third man and takes off. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Another dot! On off, Smith guides it but straight to point.
Goes short now, it is on middle. Smith looks to pull, it goes off the underedge towards short fine leg.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.

Two and that is fifty for Ben McDermott! A really good return in the side for him. He was nervous at the start but once he got going, he has played some brilliant shots. On middle, he works this through mid-wicket and takes two.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.

Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket, it is in the gap, two taken. Wanindu Hasaranga bowled the last four deliveries with that round-arm action. The 'Undertaker' is how the on-air commentators describe it.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Steven Smith walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Maxwell is dismissed off a full toss and Wanindu Hasaranga has his second. On the pads, Maxwell looks to hit it way too hard but does not get it off the middle. It is the longer part. The fielder at deep square leg runs to his left. He overruns a bit but takes a good catch to his right. Nicely done by Chamika Karunaratne.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamika Karunaratne b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Another one with a round-arm action, it is shorter and on middle, Maxwell pulls it wide of long on for two.
FOUR! First boundary for Maxwell! Short and wide outside off, this is hammered through covers and it races away to the fence.
Shorter and outside off, Ben McDermott slaps it through covers for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga (2-0-20-1) is back.
Back of a length, on off. Ben McDermott pulls it through square leg for one.
Slower one, but way, way outside off. Left alone. Wide called.
On a length, outside off. Pushed past cover for one. Maxwell is off the mark.
On a length, lands outside off and comes back in. Maxwell looks to drive but it goes through the gate.
Who will Australia send now? Glenn Maxwell is sent in to tee off.

OUT! BOWLED! Easy does it for Chamika Karunaratne! He bowls it full, on off. Josh Inglis looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits the off pole. Good work by Chamika Karunaratne but a wrong shot by Josh Inglis.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Slower and fuller, outside off. Josh Inglis drives it past the diving cover fielder and it runs to the fence. That brings up the 50-run stand.
Length ball, wide outside off. Left alone and called a wide.
Length ball, on middle. Josh shuffles across to scoop it away but misses.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on. He went for 4 in his first over.

Lucky! Full, on off. Ben McDermott looks to swipe it across the line but gets the top edge. The ball flies over the keeper. The fielder from short fine leg chases it but it lands safe. The man from third man cuts it off. Two taken.
FOUR! Up and over now! Full, on off. Ben McDermott gets under it and then lifts it over mid off. It lands short of the fence and goes over the ropes.
Slower and shorter, outside off. Slapped to mid off.
A full toss, around the waist. Heaved to deep square leg for one. Not called a no ball. Fair call.
Very full, on off. Ben looks to flick it away but gets the leading edge past cover for one.
SIX! Launched! Clobbered by Ben McDermott! Length ball, on off. He heaves it miles, miles in the air. It goes way over the square leg fence.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on. He went for 5 in his first over.
Very full, on off. Ben McDermott smacks it back to the bowler. It burts through Shanaka's hands and a single is taken.
Slower again, but on the body. Inglis swipes it to deep square leg for one.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Punched past point for a single.

Okay, the Sri Lankan team is waiting near the ropes. We have been informed that we have not lost any overs here. Josh Inglis and Ben McDermott are all in readiness. The players walk out to the middle! Dasun Shanaka will finish his over now.

Ashton Agar is having a word now. He jokes that the team is joking about Zampa's farm in the dressing room! Adds that Zampa grows a lot of stuff on his farm and it is a pretty nice place. About the game, Agar says that being only one wicket down is a good thing for them. Informs that Marcus Stoinis gave Josh Inglis his cap before the game and says that Inglis loves cricket and loves batting. Agar adds that when Inglis started playing for Western Australia, he was very mature and he is a smart cricketer. About his own place in the team, Agar says that he is loving his time with the team irrespective of whether he gets a chance to play in the middle. About the Pakistan tour, says that it is good to be in the squad and he is quite confident in his game. Mentions that Usman Khawaja spoke with the team about the tour and said that the young kids in Pakistan have not witnessed their cricketing heroes in a long time and Agar says that it adds to the importance of the tour.

Adam Lewis, the head of the groundstaff is having a word with the broadcasters. He says that we should get going pretty soon. Informs that they will need around 15 minutes to clear up things after the rain stops. Okay, it looks like the covers are being peeled off slowly.

While we wait for the rain to ease out, you could switch tabs and enjoy the match between West Indies and India. The Windies have got a good start as they have snipped 3 early wickets. The commentators here are speculating how much some of the Aussie players would fetch in the auction of the Indian T20 League which is to be held over the weekend. 2.5-3 million USD reckons Shane Warne for David Warner!

Update 2:21 pm IST (8:51 am GMT) - Uh oh, here comes the drizzle! A light one though. The players are walking off. Two members of the groundstaff, who got popular during the Ashes Test here for entertaining the crowd with their races during the rain breaks, sprint out again! Patty and Max are their names if my memory serves me right. The umpires wait for a moment near the boundary ropes as it is a light drizzle. Shane Warne, on air, informs us that we have about 25 minutes before we start losing overs. Buth Mark Waugh says that this should not be a long delay as per the rain radar.
On middle, this is pushed through mid-wicket for one.
Goes uppish but with not much timing! Fuller and outside off, Inglis lifts it over covers for two.
Brilliant running! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket with soft hands. Two taken.
Dasun Shanaka is on now.
No it does not! On middle, Inglis works it to mid on and takes one. A good start by Chamika Karunaratne!
WIDE! Down the leg side, Inglis looks to whip it but misses. A good over so far but will the extra ball cost Chamika?
A slower one on off, Inglis looks to guide it down to third man but gets it from the bottom part of the bat. The keeper dives to his right and stops it on the bounce.
Leading edge but one! Angled in on middle, Ben McDermott looks to work it on the leg side, this one holds its line, takes the leading edge and goes past backward point. Single then.
A single! Short and slower, this is pulled through square leg for one. 50 up for the Aussies. Slow going so far.

Good pace there! Shorter and outside off, Inglis looks to pull but this one takes off after landing. Inglis is beaten. Uh oh, a miss by Sri Lanka. UltraEdge shows a big spike as the ball goes past the bat. There was no appeal whatsoever. Not even a mild one.
Inglis goes for the ramp but Chamika Karunaratne bowls it short and outside off, it hits the glove and goes on the bounce to the keeper. Good adjustment by the bowler.
Change. Chamika Karunaratne has been brought on now.
On the stumps, this is played back to the bowler. A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on.
Flatter, on off. Josh stays in the crease and tucks it past mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Australia are now getting a move on. 11 from the over with two balls to go. On middle, the reverse sweep is out, it goes through point for a boundary. Nicely executed by Josh Inglis.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

SIX! The slog sweep is out and it is really well hit! The longer part of the ground but Ben McDermott does not care. He goes down on one knee and hits it just over the mid-wicket fence. A big challenge for this pair to play someone like Wanindu Hasaranga.
The leg spinner, this lands on middle and then spins away. Defended.

FOUR! Short and put away! Outside off, Inglis waits and then cuts it behind square on the off side for a boundary. His first and that ends the Powerplay. A good one for Sri Lanka. Australia are 37 for 1.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for a quick run.
Close! Fires it outside off, Ben looks to sweep but misses. It goes just past the off pole.
Ben McDermott misses out! A full toss on the pads, Ben McDermott is slightly early in the flick, it goes off a soft leading edge towards cover for no runs.
Josh Inglis is off the mark! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Googly, outside off. Inglis gets forward and blocks it well.
Josh Inglis walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Through the gate! This is why Wanindu Hasaranga is so highly rated, he gets big wickets for his captain! Googly again, this lands on middle. Aaron Finch looks to drive it straight down the ground but leaves a big gap between his bat and pad. The ball lands, turns back in, goes through the gate and hits the leg pole!
Shorter, on off. Ben McDermott mistimes it towards mid on for one.
Fuller, around off. Finch drags it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Darted on the pads. Ben McDermott gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls past square leg. Leg bye taken.
SIX! Just over! A poor ball and Ben McDermott gets a maximum. Shorter, on off. He rocks back and pulls it high in the air. Huge shouts of 'catch it' but it goes over the fielder at deep mid-wicket.
Wanindu Hasaranga is brought on now.

A huge appeal but turned down! A run out chance also goes abegging! A yorker on the pads, Finch fails to jam it out. It hits the pad and goes on the off side. Finch is in that awkward situation when he is staring at the umpire after a huge appeal and not watching the ball. The fielder at short third man has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. The impact was outside leg. But had that fielder hit, Finch would have been out.
Very well bowled again! A yorker on middle, this is played out to mid off.
Another yorker on off, Ben McDermott looks to go big but in the end, he jams it out towards mid off and gets to the other end.
Very full, almost a yorker, it is jammed back to the bowler.
Finch comes down the track and makes it into a low full toss, it is worked through square leg for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Now follows the boundary with one as he pushes it to mid off. A good over then for the Aussies. But this has been a good bowling start by Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Pulled away! First boundary and it is off the bat of Ben McDermott! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter and on off, Ben pushes it through covers for two. Still no boundary.
On middle, this is pushed to covers.

NOT OUT! Impact, umpire's call! Not a bad review. It could have gone either way. This lands outside off and it turns back in a little. Finch looks to play the paddle scoop but misses. He gets hit on the pads. An appeal as the ball rolls towards the leg side. The batters go for one as the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka review and replays show that it is hitting middle but the impact was outside off. Just a leg bye then.

Review! Sri Lanka have reviewed this for LBW. Hotspot suggests that there is no bat on it. UltraEdge confirms the same. Umpire's call on impact and Aaron Finch is safe! It was hitting the stumps but Finch is saved due to umpire's call.
Flatter and on off, Finch plays it to point.
Maheesh Theekshana will bowl now. Interesting move.

A swing and a miss! A dot to end another tidy over. Ben McDermott seems to have hurt himself. Goes short and on the body, Ben McDermott looks to pull, he tries to break the shackles but is hit on the hand.
Still no boundary conceded! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
This is a really good start by the Lankan bowlers! Outside off, seems to be a slower one, stays a touch low. Finch looks to push but misses.

Off the edge again! This time a leading one. Ben McDermott has not started off that well. On middle, Ben looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off a soft leading edge towards mid off for one.
Two off the inside edge! Length and outside off, Ben looks to push at it with no foot movement. This goes off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg for two.
That is a good sharp ball! Sees Finch walk down the track and bangs it short and on the body, Finch looks to nudge it on the leg side but this goes off the glove and on the leg side for one.
Binura Fernando will start from the other end.
A good start then by Chameera! Fuller and on middle, Ben McDermott drives it back firmly. Chameera gets down and stops it.
BEATEN! Very well bowled! Length and on off, this lands and then moves away. Ben is beaten as he tries to block.
Shot! Three! Fuller and on middle, Finch strokes it past the bowler through mid on. Wanindu Hasaranga gives it chase and keeps it down to three.
Uppish but wide of the fielder and Ben McDermott is underway! Length and on off, Ben looks to push it on the up but it flies off the outer edge down to third man for one.
Solid! Good length and on off, Ben McDermott plays it to mid off.
Australia and Finch are underway! Fuller and on middle, a little bit of shape into the batter, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Folks, we are set for the clash! Sri Lanka have taken the field. Aaron Finch and Ben McDermott walk out to bat for Australia. Dushmantha Chameera will start with the ball. Here we go...

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Avishka Fernando, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Wanindu Hasaranga, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Binura Fernando.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Ben McDermott, Josh Inglis, Steven Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
Toss - The news from the middle is that Sri Lanka have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will be without the services of Kusal Mendis as he has tested positive for Covid-19. The side may be a bit depleted but they have a few quality players in their ranks. Pathum Nissanka and Charith Asalanka are two exciting batters while Wanindu Hasaranga is probably one of the best all-rounders going around in T20 cricket. So, this side can give Australia a run for their money. An exciting clash is coming our way, so stay tuned for all the updates.

Australia have decided to rest Mitchell Marsh and David Warner - two players who played a key role in them winning the T20 World Cup. Ben McDermott, who had a great Big Bash League, is set to open with Aaron Finch and he would be eager to prove his mettle. The same goes for Josh Inglis who is set to bat at number 3. It is also the first time since the first Ashes Test in Brisbane that Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins and Josh Hazlewood will take the field together so that should be exciting for Australia.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first T20I between Australia and Sri Lanka. The defending champions of the T20 World Cup are taking the field for the first time since that final against New Zealand and they come up against a team that is still in the rebuilding phase. Sri Lanka did not have the best of times at the T20 World Cup but they do have some good players in their side. The next edition of the T20 World Cup is less than a year away so expect these sides to experiment along their way.
... Match Day ...
